close_reason: Adopted option 1 (tighten deserializer): deserialize_parent_id_three_way now rejects numbers, booleans, arrays, and nested objects with a spec-citing error message. RFC 8621 §2.3 admits only null and string; the post-diff three-way distinction is preserved (absent / null / Id-string). Added mailbox_filter_parent_id_rejects_non_spec_shapes test asserting all four non-spec wire shapes are rejected with a spec-citing error. Tests + clippy pass for jmap-mail-types and downstream jmap-mail-server. Option 2 (typed ParentIdFilter enum) filed as JMAP-zx3s.17 deferred follow-up — it's a forward-major-version type-design improvement, not a present-tense correctness fix, and would force consumer migration from Option<serde_json::Value> to Option<ParentIdFilter>.
title: MailboxFilterCondition.parent_id: Option<serde_json::Value> accepts non-spec values (arrays, numbers, bools, nested objects)
